text: [For the choirmaster For strings Of David] God, hear my cry, listen to my prayer.
From the end of the earth I call to you with fainting heart. Lead me to the high rock that stands far out of my reach.
For you are my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy.
Let me stay in your tent for ever, taking refuge in the shelter of your wings!
For you, God, accept my vows, you grant me the heritage of those who fear your name.
Let the king live on and on, let his years continue age after age.
May his throne be always in God's presence, your faithful love and constancy watch over him.
Then I shall always sing to your name, day after day fulfilling my vows.
